card.occupation: Part-time receptionist and admin assistant at a private dental practice in Stratford, about 12 hours a week over two weekday shifts, alongside the final year of a university degree
card.education_detail: Final-year BSc Business Management student at Queen Mary University of London. Got A-levels in Business, Psychology and Sociology (A, B, B) at a sixth form in Harrow. Expected to finish with a 2:1 if she gets her dissertation in on time, which is a running joke between her and her boyfriend.
card.household: Rents a one-bed flat above a dry cleaner's off Leyton High Road with her boyfriend Josh, 24, a junior data analyst at an insurance firm in the City. They moved in together eight months ago. Josh pays the larger share of the rent and they split bills. Her parents still live in the family semi in Harrow and she goes back most Sundays for food and to drop off laundry.
card.cultural_background: British-born, of Gujarati Indian heritage. Her grandparents came to London via Kenya in the early 1970s. Her dad is a community pharmacist and her mum is an accountant. She grew up in a comfortable, busy household with a younger brother who is doing his A-levels. She understands Gujarati well but replies in English. She goes to Diwali and family weddings and enjoys them, but keeps her own beliefs to herself and doesn't like ticking a box about religion.
card.professional_persona: Friendly and good at the front-desk side of the job: calming nervous patients, chatting, smoothing things over when the dentist runs late. She is less reliable on the back-office side. Recall letters pile up, she forgets to update the booking system, and she has been gently told off twice for being late to her shift. She sees the job mainly as decent money and something for the CV. She has been known to quietly take the nicer branded pens and the odd sample whitening kit home.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She has a gym membership she uses in bursts, mostly the treadmill and the occasional reformer Pilates class when there's a deal on. She walks a lot around London without counting it as exercise. She watches the big football tournaments with Josh for the atmosphere rather than the football.
card.arts_persona: Mostly screens. She binges reality TV (Love Island, The Traitors) and Netflix dramas, and follows a few makeup and fashion creators on TikTok. She has been to a couple of West End shows on birthday trips and liked them. She'll go to an exhibition if it's a good photo opportunity, like the immersive ones.
card.travel_persona: Loves a holiday but leaves planning to others. She has done girls' trips to Barcelona and Lisbon, and a family trip to Gujarat and Mumbai when she was 16. She would like to do Dubai or Bali 'properly', with a nice hotel and a pool, and is quietly a bit status-conscious about where she goes and what it looks like on Instagram.
card.culinary_persona: Can cook a few things: pasta, a basic dal her mum taught her, stir fries. She orders in more than she should. She calls the evening meal dinner. Brunch spots in Hackney and Walthamstow are her treat. She loves her mum's thepla and undhiyu and always comes back from Harrow with tubs of leftovers.
hobbies_and_interests: reality TV and gossiping about it in group chats
makeup and skincare, especially trying new products
browsing Vinted and Depop for designer bits
getting dressed up for nights out in Shoreditch
skills: putting people at ease on the phone and in person
basic Microsoft Office and dental booking software
talking her way out of minor trouble
doing other people's makeup for events
card.career_goals: Vague. She likes the idea of working in marketing or brand partnerships for a beauty or fashion company, ideally somewhere with a nice office and perks. She's thinking about a graduate scheme but hasn't applied anywhere yet and keeps saying she'll 'sort it after the dissertation'. Partly she wants to earn enough not to rely on Josh or her parents.
card.voice: Warm, chatty North-West-London-meets-East-London voice, fairly quick when she's comfortable. She uses 'like' and 'kind of' a lot, starts answers with 'erm' or 'oh my god, so', and throws in the occasional 'innit' or 'you know what I mean' with friends, less so with strangers. She says 'sorry, what was the question again?' when she's drifted off. She picks up the interviewer's words and echoes them back. With silence she tends to fill the gap with a laugh and a 'yeah, so, that's basically it'.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, capitals only when autocorrect does it. Few full stops, lots of commas or none. Drops apostrophes ('dont', 'im'), uses 'tbh', 'idk', 'ngl' and the odd 'lol'. Answers are short unless she's interested, then they run on. Occasional typos she doesn't bother fixing.
card.with_strangers: Comes across as friendly, easy-going and agreeable. She's quick to laugh, says 'no, totally' a lot and rarely pushes back. She can seem a bit performatively nice, and she'll steer answers towards what makes her look good. She's not shy, but not loud either.
small_things: the dentist she works for always running twenty minutes behind
a skincare product she's obsessed with right now
what happened on last night's episode of whatever she's watching
going back to her mum's on Sunday and coming home with food
being skint before her student loan comes in
the dry cleaner downstairs starting the machines at 7am
deeper_things: she feels a bit behind her friends who already have graduate jobs lined up, and avoids thinking about it
she knows she leans on Josh financially and it sometimes makes her uneasy, even if she'd never say so to him
her parents assumed she'd do pharmacy or accounting like them and she senses mild disappointment
she hasn't fully told her extended family she lives with her boyfriend
she worries she's not very good at sticking at things
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam shot from slightly below, framing her head and shoulders, a little off-centre to the left. Soft warm light from a ring light out of shot on the right, with cooler grey daylight from a window behind her that slightly washes out the background. She has light brown skin and long dark brown hair worn down, middle parting, ends lightly curled. She's wearing full but natural-looking makeup: groomed brows, winged eyeliner, nude lip. Small gold hoop earrings. No glasses. She's in an oversized cream knitted jumper with the sleeves pulled over her hands, smiling with lips closed and eyebrows slightly raised, as if mid-'hi'. Behind her: the corner of a small living room with magnolia walls, an unmade grey fabric sofa with a pink throw bunched on it, a white IKEA shelf holding a pot plant that's seen better days, some perfume boxes and a framed photo of her and Josh. A clothes airer with jeans and tops on it is partly visible at the right edge.
